fitReason: Verified January 2025 Assistant Professor with direct CS-compatible robot-learning methods and current master’s/PhD advising. Strong technical target; visitor capacity is unknown and Northeastern’s funding restrictions materially limit fully self-funded alternatives.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 2026 PRISM trains an MLP Gaussian action prior from frozen JEPA features and fuses it into MPPI. Its physical proof of concept reports FR3 PushT success in 7/20 trials and ARX X5 cube manipulation in 9/20. FR3 actions execute at 10 Hz with replanning every 0.5 seconds. The lead author is Ye’s current PhD advisee, independently corroborated by the lab roster. Separately, full 2025 RaycastGrasp uses trained YOLOv8 and two-second gaze selection to trigger real Franka grasping; its lead author is a current master’s advisee. Perception is learned, while semantic matching and low-level arm execution are conventional.

unknowns: Summer 2027 availability, a scoped visit project, duration, external-master acceptance, remote collaboration and lab funding all require direct confirmation.

PRISM is a preliminary preprint; controlled comparative gains are simulation results, and matched physical baselines are pending. The FR3 GPU is inconsistently listed as RTX 5080 in the body and RTX 5090 in Appendix G.

The RaycastGrasp 88% number is a detector confidence, not an 88% manipulation success estimate. Its physical demonstration lacks a reported participant/trial denominator and has same-class-object ambiguity.

Current-group student leadership is verified; ownership and access to each particular robot during Summer 2027 still require confirmation. Older UF teleoperation and Mines collaborative apparatus are not automatically Northeastern inventory.

Northeastern policy reused at 2026-09-30T23:48:24Z explicitly provides an outside-master Visiting Student process with faculty sponsorship. It requires a majority of support from non-personal/non-family sources; fully personal funding is not supported.

The engineering process estimates five to seven months from complete submission to arrival; central OGS asks at least four months. Student Non-Degree duration is three weeks to two years, but institutional approval, registration, insurance, current financial minimums and 2027 fees remain separate.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
